sceneParticle-name.label: Name
sceneParticle-name.tip: Particle Name (note: this is a label for user reference only)

sceneParticle-priority-box.label: Priority
sceneParticle-priority-box.tip:
Sorting priority of Particle at render time (render layers)
Particles with lower Priority will overlap those with higher Priority
Priority = -1: render position is offset up by one tile
Priority = 1: render position is offset down by one tile

sceneParticle-conditions.label: Conditions
sceneParticle-conditions.tip: Set a list of conditions for the Particle to be created; if they aren't met, the Particle isn't created

sceneParticle-events.label: Events
sceneParticle-events.tip:
$Particle Events
$Options
Autorun: Event triggers as soon as the Particle appears (including after reading save data)
Custom: triggered using the 'Call Event' command

sceneParticle-scripts.label: Scripts
sceneParticle-scripts.tip: Add Script files to extend Particle functions
